basis: 2026-10-29 cache-fair acquisition replay: one corpus-checkpoint fetch, one artifact listing, one independently fetched trusted Reader, and one Actions ZIP download for each active repository.
assumptions: For any nonempty task subset, charge three shared setup connector operations once and one RGP artifact ZIP download for each distinct touched repository.
GitHub source fetches reuse each unique repository/commit/path across selected tasks, regardless of task order.
All source paths required for each selected task are known from the frozen plan. Search/discovery costs are not measured.
Do not assume this conditional setup policy was actually re-executed for any subset; only the full 12-task replay was measured.
No model-token, wall-time, bytes, monetary, answer correctness, or variance claims.
